metadata.title: splitField()/cutField() Null Dereference on field.content — Screen Render DoS

sources: ApplinX REST API GetScreenResponse fields[].content (nullable — server-controlled)
transformations: splitField() line 142: f1.content.substring(0, clampedMinX) — UNSAFE (throws TypeError if null)
sinks: Unhandled TypeError propagates through Angular change detection
Screen rendering cycle crashes — user session frozen

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Client-side session DoS — screen rendering blocked, user frozen

impact.description: Terminal screen rendering completely blocked until user refreshes or re-authenticates. Purely availability impact — no data exfiltration or modification. Chained with VULN-012: send 1000 overlapping rects + null-content field = instant crash with lower overhead.

prerequisites: ApplinX backend compromised or server sends Field with null content
At least one transformation rectangle overlapping the null-content field

remediation.fix_approach: Replace f1.content.substring(x, y) with f1.content?.substring(x, y) ?? '' in all four affected locations (splitField lines 142-143, cutField lines 167, 170). Alternatively add early return when content is null.

history.note: splitField() and cutField() call .substring() on potentially-null field.content after null-safe contentLen guard
Confirmed null dereference at 4 locations (splitField 142-143, cutField 167, 170). Downgraded from HIGH to MEDIUM — DoS only, no data exposure. Chains with VULN-012 in AC-004.
